parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the internal-facing access tag. The description must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), and spaces. Chinese characters are supported.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the internal-facing access tag. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Chinese characters are supported.
